title: RenArD — Renaissance Aristophanes Digital (Translatoscope / ELAN)
notes: RenArD is the Renaissance branch of the Translatoscope project (ELAN, Litt&Arts Grenoble), offering the first XML-TEI editions of the Latin humanist translations of Aristophanes — Ploutos and Les Nuees (Clouds) translated by Alessandro da Otranto (1470), Johannes Cuno, Beatus Rhenanus, Lorenzo Giacomini etc. — presented alongside the manuscript facsimile via EVT. The harvested origins ('Translatoscope: Les Nuees / Alessandro da Otranto (1470)', 'Translatoscope: Ploutos / Beatus Rhenanus (1520)') map directly onto these translations; TEI data is deposited on Nakala. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: UMR Litt&Arts, Universite Grenoble Alpes (Malika Bastin-Hammou; ELAN project)
